name: Road Trip to the End of the World
source:
Get in, loser, we’re wedding crashing. 

Andy Min is having the worst summer: on top of dropping out of med school, she’s been uninvited from her ex-best friend’s wedding. Join her and her imaginary friend Fishy on a cross-country drive to eat burgers, crash a wedding, and perhaps even find closure.

Warning: closure sold separately.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769330/Road_Trip_to_the_End_of_the_World/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
进来吧，失败者，我们的婚礼要崩溃了。

安迪·敏正在经历最糟糕的夏天：除了从医学院退学之外，她还没有被邀请参加她前最好朋友的婚礼。与她和她想象中的朋友Fishy一起穿越全国，吃汉堡、破坏婚礼，甚至可能找到结局。

警告：封口单独出售。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769330/Road_Trip_to_the_End_of_the_World/]Steam[/url]]
